Last weekend, I had the pleasure of attending the Western Founders Network Product Design Sprint! 🚀 Our prompt was to design a digital experience using Framer to recapture the distinct feeling of 2016. My teammates Arielle Tetelbaum, sam ahn, and I focused on the theme of community. What feels more like 2016 than the people you experienced it with?
